subject: POC dataset roadmap & responsibility matrix — Springwell POC
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@springwell.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Summary & next steps from today's discovery — dataset + success criteria

Hi Liam — great conversation today, thanks for walking through the workflows. Per our call, here's a tight recap and the ask list so we can get the POC data ingestion and eval moving next week:

1) Success criteria (what Springwell will use to accept the POC):
   - Generation accuracy on triage prompts: >= 88% (human-rated, 3 raters)
   - Latency: 95th percentile < 650ms for single-turn queries in staging
   - Cost target: average inference cost <= $0.015 per 1k tokens for the trial profile

2) Data deliverables from your side:
   - Representative prompt set (CSV): 2.5k rows, columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_output_example
   - Historical query logs export (anonymized): 30 days of traffic, gzip JSONL preferred
   - Optional: 200 labeled examples for edge-case categories you flagged (fraud, billing, clinical triage)

3) Redwood next steps / proposed timeline:
   - Mon 12/7: ingestion pipeline ready for sample_prompts_v1.csv (SE to validate schema)
   - Wed 12/9: baseline eval run on curated prompts + initial qualitative review
   - Fri 12/11: sync to review results and agree canary settings / rollouts

4) Owners:
   - Springwell data delivery: Liam + data-ops@springwell.ai
   - Schema validation & ingestion: Monica Patel (SE)
   - Eval harness & metrics: Ben Carter (AE) + Priyom Das (ML Ops)

Attachments: I attached a one-page SOW draft and a template CSV for the prompt set. If the CSV format below works, please drop a sample row back to me.

Thanks — Markus

--
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: springwell_sample_prompts_v1.csv (CSV template), redwood_poc_sow_draft_v1.pdf (SOW draft)

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@springwell.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: data-ops@springwell.ai
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 09:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Summary & next steps from today's discovery — dataset + success criteria

Hi Markus — thanks for the recap and clear owners. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Success criteria: the 88% human-rated accuracy is reasonable — our QA team will do an internal sanity check but that aligns with our expectations.
- Prompt CSV: we can provide 2.5k rows but will start with a 300-row seed to validate schema (target to drop full set by Tue 12/8).
- Logs: we'll provide 14 days initially (privacy filters applied) and follow up with the 30-day dump if ingestion runs cleanly.

I'll attach a small sample (300 rows) tonight. One ask: can Redwood run the baseline eval using both a zero-shot and a few-shot (3 examples) configuration so we can compare?

— Liam
Lead Product Manager, Springwell Health
liam.oneal@springwell.ai

> Hi Liam — great conversation today, thanks for walking through the workflows. Per our call, here's a tight recap and the ask list so we can get the POC data ingestion and eval moving next week:
> ...

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 07:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Schema validation + staging ingestion plan (Springwell)

Markus / team — I've reviewed the CSV template you attached and sketched a minimal ingestion checklist:

- Required columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_output_example, category (optional), redaction_flag (Y/N)
- Schema checks: utf-8, max prompt length 4096 chars, no PII in prompt_text (we will detect and reject rows with common PII patterns)
- Ingestion steps (target Mon 12/7):
   1) Receive sample CSV (300 rows) -> run schema validator -> return validation report (Mon morning)
   2) If schema/validation clean -> stage into ephemeral bucket for evaluation (Mon afternoon)
   3) Trigger baseline eval runs (zero-shot + 3-shot) and return metrics (Wed 12/9)

I will own step 1 & 2. Priyom, can you allocate a slot on Wed for the initial eval harness? Ben, can you lead the qualitative review with Springwell PMs after the run?

— Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

> On Sun, Dec 6, 2026 at 9:11 AM Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@springwell.ai> wrote:
> > I'll attach a small sample (300 rows) tonight. One ask: can Redwood run the baseline eval using both a zero-shot and a few-shot (3 examples) configuration so we can compare?

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 01:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Eval harness slot and metric definitions

I can take the Wed slot for the harness. Proposed eval config:

- Models: rwx-small-fp16 (baseline) and rwx-large-quant (cost-optimized)
- Runs: zero-shot & 3-shot (3 examples sampled per prompt)
- Metrics: BLEU, ROUGE-L, and a human-rated relevance score (1-5) sampled for 200 prompts across categories
- Latency: measure p95 on a 100-request synthetic burst matching Springwell traffic pattern

I'll need the staged data available by 08:00 PT Wed to get full runs finished by EOD Wed. Monica, can you confirm the staging bucket path and ACL?

— Priyom
ML Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@springwell.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC dataset roadmap & responsibility matrix — Springwell POC

Markus / team — attaching the 300-row seed now (springwell_sample_prompts_v1.csv) and confirming the full 2.5k drop for Tue 12/8 EOD. Also attached is a short mapping document that notes which prompts are high priority for acceptance testing.

We agree to the zero-shot and 3-shot runs. For the human raters: we will provide two Springwell raters and ask Redwood to provide one independent rater for parity.

Attachment: springwell_sample_prompts_v1.csv

— Liam

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@springwell.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC dataset roadmap & responsibility matrix — Springwell POC

Thanks Liam — received the sample and the priority mapping. Quick confirmation on next steps and owners so we don't lose momentum:

- TODAY (Tue 12/8 AM PT): Monica will validate the CSV and stage to the ephemeral bucket (monica.patel@redwood.ai)
- WED 12/9: Priyom runs zero-shot + 3-shot harness; Ben leads qualitative review session with Springwell PMs at 3:00 PM PT (calendar invite to follow)
- FRI 12/11: Decision sync — accept/reject criteria review + SOW redline discussion

Liam — please confirm the human-rater contact info (name + email) for the two Springwell raters and we'll loop in our independent rater. Also, to speed procurement, I've attached the SOW draft — if legal at Springwell can give a quick read by Thursday we can aim for an exec signature the following week.

Appreciate the fast turnaround from your team — looking forward to the runs.

— Markus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_poc_sow_draft_v1.pdf (SOW draft)
